shortDescription: Nyrstar, owned by commodities group Trafigura, has launched a strategic review of its Budel zinc smelting operations in the Netherlands, it said on Thursday.Operations will continue as normal during the review, which is expected to conclude by the end of 2026, Nyrstar added in a statement.

children: Nyrstar, owned by commodities group Trafigura, has launched a strategic review of its Budel zinc smelting operations in the Netherlands, it said on Thursday.
Operations will continue as normal during the review, which is expected to conclude by the end of 2026, Nyrstar added in a statement.
